views.name: bowler_winning_games
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  MatchID,
  GameNumber,
  BowlerID,
  RawScore,
  HandiCapScore,
  WonGame
FROM Bowler_Scores
WHERE WonGame = 1
views.description: All individual game rows from Bowler_Scores that are winning games (WonGame=1) with core score fields preserved. One row per bowler game (match+game+bowler).

views.name: bowler_demographics
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Bowlers.BowlerID,
  Bowlers.BowlerFirstName,
  Bowlers.BowlerLastName,
  Bowlers.TeamID,
  Bowlers.BowlerCurrentAverage,
  Bowlers.BowlerCurrentHcp
FROM Bowlers
views.description: Basic bowler identity and current averaging/handicap/team info for lookup and display. One row per bowler.

views.name: match_to_tourney
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  tm.MatchID AS MatchID,
  tm.TourneyID AS TourneyID,
  t.TourneyDate AS TourneyDate,
  t.TourneyLocation AS TourneyLocation,
  tm.Lanes AS Lanes,
  tm.OddLaneTeamID AS OddLaneTeamID,
  tm.EvenLaneTeamID AS EvenLaneTeamID
FROM Tourney_Matches AS tm
LEFT JOIN Tournaments AS t
  ON tm.TourneyID = t.TourneyID
views.description: Mapping of Match_Games / Tourney_Matches to their containing tournament (date and location). One row per tournament match (MatchID).
